name: Della Dillingham Young
summary: A poor young wife who wants to buy her husband a present worthy of him.
personality: Impulsive, loving, quick to tears and quick to recover.
background: Has saved pennies for months, bargaining with grocer, vegetable man and butcher until her cheeks burned.
appearance: Slender; a cascade of brown hair reaching below her knee.

start.public_state: In the flat, counting her money.
start.inner_state: Despairing: tomorrow is Christmas and she can buy nothing worthy of Jim.

intents.name: Find Jim a present worthy of him

relationships.label: husband
relationships.summary: Her Jim. She hugs him whenever he comes home.
